root_text:
🌟 What is HMPV? 🌟 
HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) causes colds and bronchitis mainly in:
👶 Infants
👴 Older adults
🤒 Immunocompromised.
Symptoms:
Runny nose 🤧
Cough, fever 🤒
Protect Yourself:
Wash hands 🧼
Avoid sick individuals 🙅
#RamaHospital
